title: hybrid_search cannot return symbol-type entities: no symbol doc emission and no edge-sidecar search lane
wanted_capability: Exact-symbol queries should surface symbol-typed entities through bbox_hybrid_search. The resolution half landed (commit 08b49f4a: inspect/find_paths/bundle_evidence/ref_size/blame resolve symbol refs via edge-index fallback with source=edge_projection), but the retrieval half remains: no indexer emits symbol entity docs (doc_type inventory has project_file, transcript, commit, knowledge, thread, roadmap, tool_call, code_source_activation, project_graph_vertex; zero symbol), and hybrid_search has no symbol lane or search-time edge-sidecar resolution - exact-name queries hit the containing project_file chunk instead of a symbol entity. Corpus-design decision pending: emit symbol docs at index time vs a search-time edge-sidecar lane.
fallback_used: Derived current symbol refs mechanically via bbox_refactor_project_refs (defn_hash == defining chunk_hash) and verified existence through the chunk's DEFINED_IN in-edge instead of inspect/search.
evidence: live probe 2026-06-12: symbol:d723917f:KnowledgeStore:40e76235... not_found via inspect while DEFINED_IN edge names it
notes: Narrowed 2026-08-18 after Batch C verification at HEAD 075a0077: partial fix (edge-projection resolution) confirmed landed; remainder restated above. Original broader text claimed symbols wholly invisible to inspect_entity, which is no longer true.
